name: Judaga
tactics: Judagas spread out among foes, knowing they can swiftly return to their mistress’s side if an enemy threatens her. They fight to the death to protect their Oba. When a foe is down, a judaga takes the opportunity to deliver a coup de grace, attempting to sever and seize the head of its foe.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Oba's Guardian
traits.details: When the judaga starts its turn within 6 squares of Lalali-Puy, it can shift as a minor action until the end of its turn.

effect.description: The judaga shifts 6 squares and can move through enemies’ spaces during the shift. During this movement, the judaga makes the following attack.

hit.description: damage, and ongoing 15 damage (save ends). The judaga pushes the target 2 squares.
